name: Hybrid MoBA + MHA
tagline: Block-sparse attention, with full attention in the last three layers.
description: Mixture of Block Attention in the first 22 layers and full causal multi-head attention in the last three. MoBA uses 128-token blocks and a 256-token budget including the current block. Calibration kept exactly three final full-attention layers at 25 layers.
paperTitle: MoBA: Mixture of Block Attention for Long-Context LLMs
mechanism: 22 MoBA layers, then 3 full-attention layers (25 layers)
MoBA: block 128, budget 256 including the current block
FFN 6016; native value embeddings; no burn-in or auxiliary loss
limitations: Uses the repository's local block-attention kernels, not the upstream fused implementation; no optimized generation cache is claimed. Registered and admitted within the shared budget; no formal result is published yet. Parameters, memory and speed are outcomes, not controls.
